correctness.rationale: Direct one-step matrix diagonalization gives delta=max_j x_j|x_j-x_{j+1}| with x_{N+1}=0. For any δ bound the quadratic yields x_j≤(x_{j+1}+sqrt(x_{j+1}²+4δ))/2 and strict monotonic propagation forces x_j≤sqrtδ R_{N+1-j}. Norm-one gives δ≥R_N^-2, and equality recursively forces x_1=1 and every x_j=R_{N+1-j}/R_N, phases arbitrary. Identity R_k(R_k-R_{k-1})=1 proves attainment, and R_N²=2N-ΣR_k^-2 with k≤R_k²≤2k gives convergent harmonic error, R_N²=2N-(1/2)logN+O(1) and reciprocal expansion. N=1 included. The independent finite checker validated 3605 exact/near-exact cases and is not the all-N proof.
residual_risks: Only single exponent 2 for nilpotent one-step shifts; no distance-to-quasinormality theorem or arbitrary nilpotent matrix comparison.
